title: Generic direct image has invertible counit
statement: Let $D$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] with function field $K$ and generic inclusion $\eta:\operatorname{Spec}K\to D$ [def-sc-function-field]. For any abelian etale sheaf $F$ on $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], the counit $\eta^{-1}\eta_*F\to F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Use initial_generic_baseChangeNbhd at each algClosurePoint of Spec K. Its opposite is final. stalkRestrict is colimit.pre for precisely this functor, hence is an isomorphism by Mathlib Functor.Final.colimit_pre_isIso.

stalkRestrict_eq_counit identifies this isomorphism with the composite of the inverse-image stalk isomorphism and the stalk of the counit. Cancel the former isomorphism, then use naturality of uliftSheafFiberIso to transport invertibility to the universe-lifted stalk.
Apply Scheme.isIso_of_isIso_sheafFiber_map to the conservative family of universe-lifted algClosurePoint stalks.

proof_origin.place: Generic counit argument, via pointed-neighbourhood extension (02GH/01ZM/07RP) and direct final-colimit comparison instead of derived strict henselization.

mathlib_searches.query: counit of inverse image and direct image for generic point of integral scheme etale sheaves is an isomorphism
inverse image of direct image at generic point counit is an isomorphism for etale sheaves on integral scheme

lean.statement:
theorem isIso_generic_direct_image_counit
    (D : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral D]
    (F : Sheaf (Spec D.functionField).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    IsIso ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      D.fromSpecFunctionField).counit.app F)
